page.layout: Running head at top right above the table. One table: a left column of years (1541–1548) and a right column of names in groups of four, each group separated by a rule.; Only the right-hand margin survives: a column of marginal notes beside a vertical rule, with the printed page number 299 at the top. The text block to the left is cut away. At the bottom, "Eltet," sits left of the rule beside the last note, "INTERIM.".

p.note: Offensio nata inter domum Burgundicam & Ordines Frisiae Orientales propter Ioannem Falcoburg. tutelam filiorum fratris affectantem.
Maria regina Vngariae, Gubernatrix Belgici Groningam venit.
Edictum Caroli V. contra Emdanos & reliquos Frisiae Orientalis Ordines.
Diploma a Carolo V. de usu Amasi Croninganis datum Augustae in comitiis ubi tum cudebatur INTERIM.

page.notes: Names in the right column are set in a table; the years sit in the left column, one per group. Readings marked [?] are doubtful in the scan. The left margin text block is not visible, so no main text is transcribed. "Eltet," is doubtful, since it may be part of the cut text block or a stray mark. "Croninganis" and "Edictum" are doubtful readings. "refuscitata" reads as one word with a ligature. The "Amasi" spelling is copied as printed, with the long s written as s.
